name: direct-sa-to-stock-sst-upwind-replication
objective: Determine whether bounded-upwind k and omega transport avoids the asymmetric stock-SST branch when applied from the original accepted SA source, rather than attempting to recover the already asymmetric stock-SST fields.
fixed_invariants: NASA TMR altered closed NACA 0012 897x257 mesh and every polyMesh file
converged U and p copied from the same accepted SA source used by the original stock-SST diagnostic
alpha=0 deg, U=51.4815 m/s, nu=8.58e-6 m2/s, chord Reynolds number 6000174.825
incompressible simpleFoam in the same digest-pinned OpenFOAM v2512 image
pressure and velocity solvers, relaxation, gradients, laplacians, interpolation, wall distance, and force definitions
stock kOmegaSST model, default coefficients, initial k/omega/nut values, and wall/farfield conditions
all settling, trend, residual, symmetry, and NASA agreement tolerances

predeclared_outputs.primary_effect: final-100 mean force difference from the original linearUpwind-turbulence stock-SST diagnostic
predeclared_outputs.settling: final-100 peak-to-peak <= max(0.001, 1% of absolute coefficient mean)
predeclared_outputs.trend: projected absolute change over 500 iterations within Cd 0.0002, Cl 0.004, and CmPitch 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.residuals: final-100 maximum initial residual <= 1e-5 for p, Ux, Uy, k, and omega
predeclared_outputs.zero_angle_symmetry: absolute mean Cl <= 0.004 and absolute mean quarter-chord CmPitch <= 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.force_agreement: absolute mean Cd minus NASA CFL3D SST Cd <= 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.negative_k: report occurrence count, worst minimum, and final minimum; no post-hoc acceptance tolerance

decision_rule: This replication may become the stock-SST source for an exact-SSTm comparison only if provenance, invariants, runtime, model, finite history, horizon, settling, trend, residual, and zero-angle symmetry gates all pass. NASA force agreement remains required for strict Gate 2. No threshold may be weakened after observing results.
